verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no user-definable rules engine in AgentMail, meaning no way to set a condition that triggers an action automatically. Webhooks and WebSockets only deliver events to the developer's own code, which is a building block for automation rather than the capability itself. Lists are a narrow allow/block filter by address or domain, an adjacent control rather than general event-to-action rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
